Reconstructed all 14 rational kernels at d=1..4 exactly from the character sum. At d=3 the only numerator negative coefficient is absorbed by strictly positive 12h²-14h+22; d<=2 follow by coordinate marginalization. At h=3/2 rho_1=0 and rho_j<0 for j>=2, and the d4 diagonal is exactly -3/1804; termwise binomial monotonicity extends negativity to all d>=4. At d4 all four offdiagonal numerators have positive coefficients, while diagonal is octic P(h) divided by positive quadratics. Descartes two sign changes and signs at h=0,3/2,infty imply exactly two positive roots alpha 1.46546725520286 and beta 5.52994947048244, yielding [0,alpha] union [beta,infty). The linear mass eigenvector is preserved, giving row and column sums one. Independent exact SymPy recalculation verifies rational identities and root location; infinite frontier uses the analytic argument.
